about.title: Sergi Cebrián
about.subtitle: From stumbling into archery by accident at Vall de Núria to the Spanish National Team and building an independent school in Terrassa.
about.bioLead: My name is Sergi Cebrián, and I've been immersed in sports since I was very young. I've practiced many—martial arts, swimming, football—but most seriously snowboarding, hockey (which I still play today), and archery.
bioParagraphsBeforeCallout: I discovered archery in 2010 purely by accident while trying different outdoor activities at Vall de Núria, and it hooked me from the very first moment—from the very first arrow. I have to admit shooting came quite naturally to me, and very early on I started standing out among those around me.

My competitive streak and the athletic upbringing shaped by practicing so many sports led me to debut in official tournaments—and even at a Spanish National Championship—less than six months after shooting my first arrow. Looking back with perspective, I can say those results were genuinely strong. Yet one thing that surprised me right away was how casual and recreational the sport still felt, even inside a National Championship. It became clear to me that both the sport itself and I had a long road ahead.

I started out shooting Barebow, completely self-taught, studying how Olympic archers shot on television. I quickly spotted the gap between the more 'instinctive' styles and the procedures executed by professional archers. My first goal was to develop my own homegrown technique that would allow me to shoot any type of bow the exact same way. That defined the first half of my career: I soon began winning medals across Catalonia and Spain, and my competitive and training experience never stopped growing.
about.epiphanyIntro: Everything I learned through tournaments, travel, and the thousands of arrows I shot every month led me to a realization that changed my life:
about.epiphanyCallout: The secret wasn't in a spotless textbook technique, a specific school, or any rigid line of work—the secret of archery lies in your head, your heart, and the emotions with which you live what you do. And when it comes to those three things, there are no secrets.
bioParagraphsAfterCallout: I've been fortunate to travel widely and live in places like the United States and Sweden, dedicating 100% of my time there to shooting more arrows, soaking up how archery is lived abroad, and stepping into Olympic Recurve. I walked away from a discipline where I was stacking up Catalan, Spanish, and international medals just to start over again as a beginner. In this new chapter, though, I had the privilege of working under the wing of former Spanish National Coach and current USA Archery Head Coach Elías Cuesta—truly one of the greats. Unlike the rest of my career, I finally had a coach, and that gave me priceless growth in every sense.

Those were 10 months of relentless work and fresh knowledge, exploring techniques very different from what I was used to. I was living in Sweden at the time, and COVID and distance eventually parted our ways, leaving me with lasting lessons on how things must be done—and just as importantly, what things need to be stripped away.

With the recurve bow I have never shown the effortless touch I had with barebow, yet through sheer work I built a strong medal record in Catalonia and Spain, earning international selection with the Spanish National Team in Field Archery.

My independence and conviction in my own way of working led me to create 'La Cova del Drac'—an archery school and technical training center where I put my passion and experience at the disposal of anyone who wants to share this wonderful sport with me.

about.quote: The arrow never lies. Every shot is a mirror of your mind, rhythm, and your inner calm.

methodology.title: Philosophy & Methodology
methodology.subtitle: No closed schools or rigid dogma: one universal shooting foundation adaptable to any bow, where your head, heart, and emotions make the real difference.

pillars.title: Consistency
pillars.subtitle: A Universal, Natural Technique
pillars.description: We build a coherent, honest way of shooting that works across any bow type, free of artificial complexity and clear on what unnecessary habits to strip away.

pillars.title: Focus
pillars.subtitle: Mind, Rhythm & Inner Calm
pillars.description: Every arrow mirrors your state of mind. We train quiet focus, personal pacing on the line, and staying fully present one shot at a time.

pillars.title: Respect
pillars.subtitle: True Sport & Shared Passion
pillars.description: We treat archery with genuine sporting rigor while keeping it a welcoming place to grow together—grounded in safety, camaraderie, and respect for the craft.

pillars.title: Self-awareness
pillars.subtitle: Head, Heart & Emotions
pillars.description: Where it truly counts, there are no secrets: we learn to read what you feel at full draw and channel the emotions you bring to training and competition.

blocks.title: Dogma-Free Form Foundation
blocks.description: Shot mechanics tailored to each person and bow—from your first day at the school to high-level coaching—keeping what works and discarding noise.

blocks.title: Competition & Field Craft
blocks.description: Real-world know-how forged over thousands of arrows indoors, outdoors, and on field courses: shot rhythm, reading terrain, and tournament composure.

blocks.title: Emotional Clarity Under Pressure
blocks.description: Honest mental and emotional work when stepping onto the tournament line, starting fresh in a new discipline, or facing decisive arrows.

blocks.title: Practical Gear Harmony
blocks.description: Clear, sensible tuning and understanding of your setup—barebow, recurve, compound, or traditional—so your bow supports your shot seamlessly.

facilities.title: High-Performance Facilities
facilities.subtitle: Engineered specifically for elite precision, technical safety, and continuous athletic progression across all distances.

lanes.title: High-Precision Indoor Hall
lanes.description: Official FITA indoor competition range. High-CRI 95 glare-free shadowless LED lighting, acoustic treatment, and reinforced Kevlar safety backstop.
specs: Instant replay monitors at the shooting line

lanes.title: Technical Mid-Range Line
lanes.description: Dedicated lane for indoor-to-outdoor transitions, sight calibration, arrow flight stability tests, and progressive archer development.
specs: Postural feedback mirrors on the line

lanes.title: Compound & Barebow Range
lanes.description: Official World Archery distance range for Compound 50m matches and national outdoor Barebow competition training.
specs: High-speed arrow stopping backstops (up to 340 fps)

lanes.title: Olympic Recurve Field
lanes.description: The official Olympic distance for Recurve archery. Full outdoor simulation with wind management, elevation, and tournament line protocols.
specs: Elevated platform for coach perspective & filming

zones.title: Master Bow Workshop & String Building
zones.description: String stretching jig, digital arrow spine testers, heavy-duty compound bow press, and dedicated paper tuning chamber for micron-level setup.

zones.title: Biomechanical Video Lab at 240 fps
zones.description: Multi-angle ultra-high-speed cameras analyzing clicker expansion, finger release purity, stabilizer harmonics, and arrow clearing dynamics.

zones.title: Scapular Warm-Up & Physical Conditioning
zones.description: Training zone equipped with variable resistance bands, bow simulators, stretching benches, and rotator cuff injury prevention gear.

facilities.accessInfoText: By appointment only. Private 1-on-1 coaching or small groups capped at 4 archers to guarantee 100% individual oversight. Smart card entry for accredited federated members.
